Question B-005-003-004. Lesson link: L-005-02.

Why the correct answer is right: An open circuit breaks the path, so no current is drawn.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: A short circuit would draw excessive current, not no current.
- sourceIndex 2: A reactive circuit is an AC behaviour description, not the fault that stops all DC current here.
- sourceIndex 3: A closed circuit provides a complete path and can draw current.
